tasks.title: Tenancy middleware: prisma.$extends patch + crossTenant primitive
acceptance: `apps/api/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts` replaces the existing patch with `$extends({ query: { $allModels: { ... } } })` so `$transaction(async tx => ...)` clients inherit scope.

Patch covers all 15 ops (`findMany`, `findFirst`, `findUnique`, `findUniqueOrThrow`, `findFirstOrThrow`, `create`, `createMany`, `update`, `updateMany`, `upsert`, `delete`, `deleteMany`, `count`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`) for every model in `HOUSEHOLD_SCOPED_MODELS`.

`prisma.crossTenant(reason: string, fn: (raw: PrismaClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>` exists, logs structured `crossTenant.invoked {reason, callerStack}`, and is the only path to a non-scoped client.

Existing event types/payloads emitted by these schedulers are preserved verbatim.

tasks.title: HMAC hashing helpers + constant-time compares; timing-equalize verifyOtpForSecurity
acceptance: `apps/api/src/common/hash.ts` exports `hmacOtp(value)` and `hmacRefresh(value)` using HMAC-SHA-256 keyed by `OTP_PEPPER` / `REFRESH_PEPPER`; bare `sha256` is removed from `auth.service.ts` and `me/email-change.service.ts`.
All hex compares in `auth.service.ts:80,164,276` and `me/email-change.service.ts:92` use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` with a length pre-check.
`last-seen.middleware.ts:hashIp` switches to HMAC-SHA-256 keyed by validated `SESSION_SALT`.
`verifyOtpForSecurity` and `verifyOtp` return the identical response shape and run a constant-time noop on the unknown-user branch.

Pino `redact` paths extended to `req.body.refreshToken`, `req.body.code`, `req.body.otp`, `req.body.pin`, `req.body.email`, `req.headers["x-refresh-token"]`.
`http-exception.filter.ts:41` sanitizes Prisma errors before logging (drops `clientVersion`, scrubs `postgresql://` URLs).
Shared `maskEmail(email)` helper exists and replaces every raw-email log site in `mail.service.ts:31,38,46,54,60`.

tasks.title: IdempotencyInterceptor: body-hash + 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT + (userId,key) lookup
acceptance: `apps/api/src/common/idempotency.interceptor.ts` hashes the canonical body (`sha256(JSON.stringify(sortedKeys(body)))`), stores `request_hash` on first use, and looks up by `(userId, key)`.
Replay with the same `request_hash` returns the cached response (single DB write); replay with a different hash returns HTTP 409 with `{error:{code:'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', message, details}}`.
First-write race protection: insert uses `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` (or equivalent transaction) so concurrent first-writes resolve to one canonical row.
tasks.notes: First attempt left errors.ts idempotencyConflict helpers but did not rewrite interceptor (still uses where:{key}). Re-dispatch.

`@UseInterceptors(IdempotencyInterceptor)` is applied to all 13 ops listed in the spec API table (push-tokens POST/DELETE, households POST, invites create/accept, security verify-pin, security reset-pin, loans compute, all `/auth/*` mutating routes).

Typed shape for `verifyOtpForSecurity` request is `{email, otp}` and response is `{otpToken, expiresAt: string}`; consumed by web + mobile call sites via the regenerated client.
